name: Pixel valley
doc: A side-scrolling pixel landscape drawn on a low-res grid: banded sky, a slatted sun that swells on the bass, drifting clouds, four parallax mountain ranges (the far one's peaks are the spectrum) that bounce on the bass, a lake mirroring it all with shimmer lines, and a tree line in front. Times of day: dawn, day, dusk, night (stars twinkle on the highs).

pixels.doc: grid height in pixels; match the pixel-art effect

speed.doc: scroll speed (the front layer moves fastest)

bounce.doc: how far the layers jump on the bass

kick.doc: extra jump and sky flash; bind to an onset envelope
